facts.fact: Adwave's budget framework for a startup or very early-stage business at $500 to $1,000/month recommends 100% digital (Google Ads for high-intent keywords).
facts.quote:
### Startup or very early stage ($500 to $1,000/month)

*   100% digital (Google Ads for high-intent keywords)

facts.fact: Adwave's budget framework for a growing business at $1,000 to $3,000/month recommends 60% digital and 40% CTV.
facts.quote:
### Growing business ($1,000 to $3,000/month)

*   60% digital, 40% CTV

facts.fact: Adwave's budget framework for an established business at $3,000 to $10,000/month recommends 40 to 50% digital, 30 to 40% CTV, and 10 to 20% email/retention.
facts.quote:
### Established business ($3,000 to $10,000/month)

*   40 to 50% digital, 30 to 40% CTV, 10 to 20% email/retention

facts.fact: Adwave's budget framework for a scaling business at $10,000+/month recommends 30 to 40% CTV, 30 to 40% digital, and 20 to 30% other channels.
facts.quote:
### Scaling business ($10,000+/month)

*   30 to 40% CTV, 30 to 40% digital, 20 to 30% other (email, content, events)

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a 50% TV and 50% digital split for home services businesses such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical.
facts.quote: Recommended split: 50% TV, 50% digital.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a 45% TV, 45% digital, and 10% email/retention split for healthcare businesses such as dentists, chiropractors, and med spas.
facts.quote: Recommended split: 45% TV, 45% digital, 10% email/retention.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a 40% TV, 40% digital, and 20% email/loyalty split for restaurants and food service.
facts.quote: Recommended split: 40% TV, 40% digital, 20% email/loyalty.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a 50% TV, 35% digital, and 15% content/email split for professional services firms such as lawyers, accountants, and consultants.
facts.quote: Recommended split: 50% TV, 35% digital, 15% content/email.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends a 35% TV, 50% digital, and 15% email/social split for retail and e-commerce businesses.
facts.quote: Recommended split: 35% TV, 50% digital, 15% email/social.
